Container.Name: SmartBM
Container.Overview: Smart Bookmark Manager: self-hosted bookmark library with a web app and sync server for the Edge extension. Default login after first start: admin / admin (you must change it immediately).

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app and the extension.

Config.Name: Data (database and secret key)
Config.Description: SQLite database and the session key. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Allow private link details
Config.Description: Set to 1 to let the server read page details of links on your own network.
